youtube_title: Do you keep your word? | Psalm 15
youtube_description:
Would the people around you say you keep your word, even when it costs you? Psalm 15 asks God, "O LORD, who shall sojourn in your tent? Who shall dwell on your holy hill?" (Psalm 15:1).

The word for sojourn is the Hebrew gur (GOOR): to live somewhere as a guest. The answer reads like a portrait: someone who walks with integrity and speaks truth from the heart, who doesn't slander, who keeps a promise even when it hurts, and who won't take a bribe against the innocent (Psalm 15:2-5). And it ends with a promise: "He who does these things shall never be moved" (Psalm 15:5).

Today's step: keep one promise you'd rather break.

Day 15 of the Psalms, one chapter a day. Follow @thebibleexplainedai so you don't miss Psalm 16.

Read it: Psalm 15:1-5
